about: E42 Amendment 2, which masked term moves the decomposition with nothing to copy, then the cipher copy with the term(s) that hold still (reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_e42-teacher-new-behaviour.md -> 'Amendment 2'; decisions.md, card decision-e42-masked). Task rand32 only, one job. Every recipe is Amendment 1's (E42's arm A: task windows, Adam 1e-5, batch 32, batch-order seed 0, 1000 steps, Gamma and Delta frozen; loss arm-A-weighted KL(teacher || unmasked student) + masked terms matched to the teacher) with commute.masked_terms' weights: 'ci' = CI-masked 0.5, stochastic 0; 'st' = CI-masked 0, stochastic 0.5; 'trig' = both 0.5, each read as its KL at the trigger alone (no weight on the other 40 positions). A term with weight 0 is computed without a gradient and logged; the batches and mask draws are Amendment 1's. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check. Expected: pass, floor 0.2088 on an L40 (E42's), pass line 1.24, fail line 1.81. Stop
controls.G1: E42's: the regenerated teacher's held-out P(target) at step 10 within 0.02 of E10's (rand32 0.5847, rand1 0.9982). Stop
controls.G2: the trainer's unmasked term with the teacher at W0, on its first batch: the component path's KL to the target model, arm A's weighting. Expected about 1e-3 (E37 Amendment 1: 0.00065 per Pile position). Above 0.01: stop (the trainer's forward is not the model's). Amendment 1 read 0.0016
controls.M0_ci, M0_st: stage 1, both always, before the teacher: recipe 'ci' and recipe 'st' with the teacher at W0, 1000 steps, Pile harness. Expected if a recipe holds still: P(target) and trigger CI-masked P(target) at W0's (under 1e-3), damage elsewhere under 0.02, adversarial ratio 0.8-1.24, stochastic about 1. Amendment 1's M0 (both terms) read 25.99 / 1.028. Scored as C_ci, C_st
controls.M0_trig: only when M0_ci and M0_st both fail: recipe 'trig' with the teacher at W0, as above. Scored as C_trig. If it fails too the job stops: no copy (decision-e42-criterion stays as it is)
controls.references: W0's trigger cells and E42's saved arm-A copy re-read at the trigger in this job: its trigger CI-masked P(target) expected within 0.005 of E42's logged 0.007 (rand32) and 0.001 (rand1) (bf16 rounding of the saved offsets). Reported, not a stop

measurements.Pile verdict: faith_score.state_verdict: P(target) >= 0.9, then the adversarial and stochastic Pile ratios to this job's W0 seed 0, each against its own floor (pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f))
measurements.control class: the Pile verdicts of faith_score.state_verdict (each ratio against this job's W0 floor: pass <= 1.5 / (1 + f), fail >= 1.5 (1 + f); f = 0.209 on the L40 gives 1.24 / 1.81 adversarial, 1.497 / 1.503 stochastic), read whatever P(target) is
measurements.held-out P(target): arms.heldout_of: the target model W0 + delta-W at the trigger, mean over held-out windows
measurements.trigger CI-masked P(target): local_faith.route_split's p_cells L11: mean over the 97 held-out windows of P(table[key]) at the trigger from the model built from the subcomponents alone under Gamma's masks on the state's own activations, Delta out

noise_floors: held-out P(target) between batch orders 0.005 on task text (E34 Amendment 4); W0's adversarial ratio between adversary seeds 0.21 on the L40; a trained copy's ratio between batch orders up to 25% (E34 Amendment 4); the trigger CI-masked P between batch orders is unmeasured: the 0.1 and 0.5 lines sit 14x and 70x above E42's rand32 copy (0.007); a control's adversarial ratio between batch orders is unmeasured (Amendment 1's M0 read 11 and 25 nats on its two 128-row blocks)

tree: a control holds when its class is 'pass' or 'inconclusive'. Exactly one of M0_ci, M0_st holds -> the copy M_<that recipe>; both hold -> M_ci (the term that targets the trigger reading); neither -> M0_trig, then M_trig if it holds, else stop. A copy run after an 'inconclusive' control: its fail or inconclusive is not attributed to copying
